name: shop-siren~p2
task: Each time the siren starts ringing, turn it off.

value.feedback: NO CHANGES NEEDED: The task 'Each time the siren starts ringing, turn it off' is a whenever-rule, so Response(siren_ringing, switch_toggled) hard is the right template. Since siren_ringing is a lasting condition that only ends when the switch is toggled, the Response stays owed while the siren rings and closes on the toggle, exactly matching the task. The rule-only warning is valid: siren_ringing is a condition, not a commanded goal, so an empty FINAL_STATES is correct here.

texts: Whenever siren_ringing, switch_toggled must eventually happen.
machine:
REWARD_MACHINE:
STATES: u0, u1
INITIAL_STATE: u0
FINAL_STATES:
DEFAULT_REWARD: 0
TRANSITION_FUNCTION:
(u0, siren_ringing&!switch_toggled) -> u1
(u1, switch_toggled) -> u0
REWARD_FUNCTION:
(u0, siren_ringing&!switch_toggled, u1) -> -1
(u1, switch_toggled, u0) -> 1
